import numpy as np

# Data for "20 years and after" taxable treasury bonds (July 1953 - June 1956)
# Period: July 1953 through June 1956 (36 months)
# Month index: 1 = July 1953, 36 = June 1956

yields = [
    3.25,  # 1953-July
    3.22,  # 1953-August
    3.19,  # 1953-September
    3.06,  # 1953-October
    3.04,  # 1953-November
    2.96,  # 1953-December
    2.90,  # 1954-January
    2.85,  # 1954-February
    2.73,  # 1954-March
    2.70,  # 1954-April
    2.72,  # 1954-May
    2.70,  # 1954-June
    2.62,  # 1954-July
    2.60,  # 1954-August
    2.64,  # 1954-September
    2.65,  # 1954-October
    2.68,  # 1954-November
    2.68,  # 1954-December
    2.77,  # 1955-January
    2.92,  # 1955-February
    2.92,  # 1955-March
    2.92,  # 1955-April
    2.91,  # 1955-May
    2.91,  # 1955-June
    2.96,  # 1955-July
    3.02,  # 1955-August
    3.00,  # 1955-September
    2.96,  # 1955-October
    2.96,  # 1955-November
    2.97,  # 1955-December
    2.94,  # 1956-January
    2.93,  # 1956-February
    2.98,  # 1956-March
    3.10,  # 1956-April
    3.03,  # 1956-May
    2.98,  # 1956-June
]

# Create month index (1, 2, 3, ..., 36)
X = np.array(range(1, len(yields) + 1))
Y = np.array(yields)

# OLS: Y = a + b*X
# b = sum((X - mean(X))*(Y - mean(Y))) / sum((X - mean(X))^2)
# a = mean(Y) - b*mean(X)

n = len(X)
mean_x = np.mean(X)
mean_y = np.mean(Y)

numerator = np.sum((X - mean_x) * (Y - mean_y))
denominator = np.sum((X - mean_x) ** 2)

b = numerator / denominator
a = mean_y - b * mean_x

print(f"OLS Regression: Y = {a:.6f} + {b:.6f} * X")
print(f"Mean X: {mean_x}, Mean Y: {mean_y}")
print(f"Sum of squared residuals: {np.sum((Y - (a + b*X))**2):.6f}")

# Predict for July 1956 (month 37)
X_forecast = 37
Y_forecast = a + b * X_forecast
print(f"\nForecast for July 1956 (month 37): {Y_forecast:.6f}")
print(f"Rounded to 3 decimal places: {round(Y_forecast, 3)}")

# Also verify the calculations
print("\n--- Verification ---")
print(f"X values: 1 to {n}")
print(f"Y values: {yields}")
EOF
